rapport_notes: Excellent empathy responding to a customer's traumatic past moving experience (no-shows, broken furniture), patient through a complex multi-location (storage + no landing home yet) scenario.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'do you have any special instructions concerns or stresser about moving in general or about this move' — asked well after extensive logistics/storage discovery.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer described horrible past experiences (no-show movers, broken dining table); rep gave one thorough, empathetic answer covering vetting and damage coverage but did not ask a follow-up question to dig further.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'if we go over we only charge on every fifteen minute increments' — full hour-range anchor explicitly deferred to the walkthrough.

top_strength: Responded to the customer's specific trauma (broken furniture, no-show movers) with a detailed, credible answer covering vetting, disassembly skill, and damage coverage.
coaching_note: The 'we'll send you their names ahead of time' Meet Your Mover line and the Communication differentiator (day-before call/inbox updates) never came up at all — worth folding both in even on a walkthrough-routed call.
